invariants.rationale: The method immediately calls map.getProperties(), so map must not be null.
The code accesses map.getProperties() directly and expects a valid Properties object; otherwise, a NullPointerException would occur.
The code calls map.getLayers() and further calls .size() and .get(0), so map.getLayers() must not be null.
Layer lists are typically non-negative in size, and the code uses map.getLayers().size() for conditional logic.
The method fetches and uses these properties, so at least one of these keys likely exists in typical usage.
